title: Generally Available: OneLake catalog—a complete catalog for discovery, management, and governance

content.text:
OneLake
catalog is a complete solution to explore, manage, and govern your
entire Fabric data estate. The OneLake catalog comes with two tabs, Explore and
Govern, that can help all Fabric users discover and manage trusted data, as
well as provide governance for data owners with valuable insights, recommended
actions, and tooling. Since the OneLake catalog is an evolution of the OneLake
data hub, it already shows up in Microsoft 365 such as Excel and Teams and many
other products in the Microsoft cloud for easy data consumption. You can also complement and extend the capabilities
of the OneLake catalog by connecting it with Microsoft Purview Data Governance
solution. The Explore tab is now generally available and the Govern tab will be
coming soon in preview.
content.html: OneLake catalog is a complete solution to explore, manage, and govern your entire Fabric data estate. The OneLake catalog comes with two tabs, Explore and Govern, that can help all Fabric users discover and manage trusted data, as well as provide governance for data owners with valuable insights, recommended actions, and tooling. Since the OneLake catalog is an evolution of the OneLake data hub, it already shows up in Microsoft 365 such as Excel and Teams and many other products in the Microsoft cloud for easy data consumption. You can also complement and extend the capabilities of the OneLake catalog by connecting it with Microsoft Purview Data Governance solution. The Explore tab is now generally available and the Govern tab will be coming soon in preview.
